description:
Bad Golf App is the free app for your regular golf group — one shared live scorecard, GPS distances, real handicaps, and every side game you already play, scored automatically in units so nobody is doing napkin math at the 19th hole.

⛳ PLAY LIVE WITH YOUR CREW
Start a round, share the invite, and everyone's phone shows the same live scorecard. Friends at home can follow along hole by hole. Finished rounds save automatically to everyone's history.

📍 GPS DISTANCES ON EVERY HOLE
Front, middle and back yardages to the green, plus lay-up and carry numbers on mapped holes, on more than 11,000 U.S. courses with scorecards, tee ratings and slope. Missing your home course? Add and map it yourself in minutes.

🐺 EVERY SIDE GAME, SCORED FOR YOU
Skins with carry-overs, Nassau with the Huckle press, Wolf, Vegas, Banker, Hammer, Stableford, Quota, Match Play, Best Ball, Scramble, Ryder Cup, Split Sixes, Niners, Bingo Bango Bongo, Umbrella, Pot of Gold, greenies, sandies, Snake, chip-ins, closest to the pin, long drive and more. Pick your games at setup and Bad Golf App keeps score, applies handicaps, and shows the Unit Totals card when the round ends. Bad Golf App just keeps score.

📊 A REAL HANDICAP
Post your rounds and get a Handicap Index calculated with World Handicap System math — score differentials, best-of-20, net double bogey caps — so matches between a 5 and a 20 are actually fair.

🏅 LEAGUES & 🏆 TOURNAMENTS
Create a league season and Bad Golf App builds the weekly matchups, flights, handicaps, standings and playoffs. Running a buddies trip or member-guest? Multi-day events with groups, tee times, field-wide side games and a live event leaderboard.

📈 KNOW YOUR GAME
Fairways, greens in regulation, putts, sand saves, scoring mix and round-by-round trends, plus 75 badges for the great shots and the bad ones.

👥 BUILT FOR THE GROUP, NOT THE GRINDERS
Bad Golf App is not a tour-pro training tool. It is for the Saturday crew that plays the same games every week and wants the score kept straight, beyond argument.

Free. No subscription, no ads. Bad Golf, Better Times.
